examples.text: And as wililye as thoſe ſhrewes that beguyle hym haue holpe hym to inuolue and intryke the matter: I ſhall vſe ſo playn and open a way therin, that euery man ſhall well ſee the trouth.

glosses: To cause (time) to seem to pass quickly, by way of pleasant diversion.

examples.text: They beguiled the time by backbiting and intriguing against each other in a foolish kind of way.

glosses: To tease (someone) by offering something desirable but keeping it out of reach.
